name: list-sessions-paged
prompt: The unpaginated list variant is too blunt for large stores. Add a paged accessor: func (s *Store) ListPage(offset, limit int) ([]Session, int) in session.go. It returns up to limit live sessions starting at offset in the same canonical order as List (LastSeen ascending, ID ascending as tiebreak), plus the TOTAL count of live sessions (so callers can compute pages). offset < 0 or limit <= 0 must return an empty slice and the total count. The store must not be mutated. Note: another Store method already named List may exist or not — if it does not, do NOT add one; this task is only about ListPage.
